runner.identity_preservation: Runner bytes are deliberately unchanged in revision 3 because the frozen R3 oracle first asserts this exact SHA-256. M27 changes the effective policy path through its frozen Ruby preload; changing runner.rb itself would cause a non-causal identity failure before --mode policy-self-check executes.
runner.execution_contract: A future unified diff is admitted only for the exact candidate HEAD, a clean tracked tree, unique git-apply, and recipe target paths. A focused command kills only with a non-zero result plus an attributable public witness. Success is a survivor. Timeout, crash, ambiguous or absent patch, path escape, missing witness, identity mismatch, application/reversal failure, or dirty restoration is Unknown. The frozen public policy-self-check is the direct M27 observer; runner bytes stay identical to its R3 identity and M27 mutates the nested process policy through the frozen preload recipe.
runner.reversibility: Each mutation is applied alone; ensure reverses its exact unified diff and requires a clean tracked tree before the next mutation.

materialization_policy.when: Only after the candidate commit and published oracle identities exist.
materialization_policy.how: The adversary mechanically instantiates each frozen semantic recipe as exactly one unified diff under 00_nucleo/diagnosticos/p1431-mutations/materialized/<candidate>/Mxx.patch. It may select the unique candidate anchor but may not change target observable, transform, killers, boundary controls, target-file allowlist or Unknown policy.
materialization_policy.ambiguity: Zero or multiple valid anchors, a required semantic choice not fixed by the recipe, or a patch outside the target-file allowlist is Unknown and blocks the mutation gate.
materialization_policy.receipt: Every execution receipt records candidate commit/tree, recipe and patch SHA-256, command, order, elapsed time, stdout/stderr digest, classification and reason code.

classification.killed: Violated with the mutation's attributable expected reason code and public killer witness.
classification.survived: Preserved/MUTATION_SURVIVED; blocks the score and seal.
classification.unknown: Unknown; receives no credit, remains in the denominator, and blocks preseal/final admission.
classification.score_formula: valid semantic mutations classified Violated / all 27 valid semantic mutations
classification.family_rule: M10 contains two required physical variants but remains one contract mutation family: it earns one numerator unit only if both variants are Violated and their known-field boundary controls retain the frozen classifications.
